art_direction: 银白长发女性双手在后脑束发，两肘形成三角轮廓，荧光绿上衣与紫色短裤置于亮紫撞色背景。
composition_variation: An exceptionally beautiful original 27-year-old adult anime woman with long pearlescent silver hair, lavender undersides, sharp emerald eyes, elegant adult cheekbones and a poised half-smile directed at the viewer. She gathers her hair into a ponytail using both hands behind her head. Both elbows form a strong asymmetrical triangular silhouette; show two anatomically plausible arms and relaxed shoulders. Her weight rests on one leg while the other knee bends slightly. Frame from hair to mid-thigh so her face is substantially larger and more detailed than in a distant full-body illustration. Outfit: opaque acid-lime cap-sleeve crew-neck summer top tucked into high-waisted violet tailored shorts, simple silver earrings. Relaxed movement and secure clothing. Camera at face height, gently three-quarter frontal. Ultraviolet background contains one large neon-lime circle low behind her shoulders and minimal cobalt graphic arcs. Top quarter is an intense violet field. Fluorescent yellow-green bounce on silver hair, rich blue shadow shapes, precise eyelashes, brilliant emerald irises and luminous peach skin. Bold graphic poster craft without letters. The raised-arm triangle and exquisite close facial design dominate.

wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Compressed contact sheet inspected: cyan ponytail turning through a stride, silver hair gathered with raised arms, crimson bob leaning with crossed arms and one bent knee. Strong magenta-cyan, lime-violet and cobalt-vermilion palettes; distinct silhouettes and larger detailed adult anime faces. Visible hands coherent and outfits opaque. Elbows and trailing hair partly extend beyond crop as intentional composition; all key hands and faces remain visible.
